title: Replace logo with uploaded version and enforce solid background

requirements.text: Replace the site logo displayed in the Header and Footer (currently loaded from /assets/generated/indomills-logo.dim_512x256.png) with the newly uploaded logo image (1000066378-removebg-preview.png), ensuring it renders very sharp/clear and has a clean single-color background (no transparency/edge artifacts). Keep all other website content, layout, colors, routes, navigation links, and Call/WhatsApp CTAs unchanged.

quotes: Is logo ko hi place kro ek Dum saaf clear single background colour

acceptanceCriteria: Header logo and Footer logo both display the updated logo using the existing path /assets/generated/indomills-logo.dim_512x256.png (no code-path changes needed).
The exported logo has a uniform single-color background (no transparency checkerboard, fringing, or rough edges).
The logo appears crisp (not blurry) on mobile and desktop at the current rendered sizes (Header h-9/h-11; Footer h-12).
No other UI sections, navigation, routes, CTAs, or copy are modified.

constraints: Do not modify backend code or add backend endpoints; logo must be served as a static frontend asset.
Do not change the logo src paths used in frontend/src/components/layout/Header.tsx and frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.tsx (keep /assets/generated/indomills-logo.dim_512x256.png).
Keep existing header/footer styling and all existing site content/CTAs unchanged; only update the logo asset output.
nonGoals: Creating new pages, changing SEO metadata, or adjusting site-wide theme colors.
Redesigning the header/footer layout or changing navigation/CTA behavior.

edits: Create a crisp logo export with a clean single-color background and proper padding (1000066378-removebg-preview.png > indomills-logo.dim_512x256.png)
